source_units.text: Vous pouvez me suivre, c'est à deux minutes d'ici.

cards.learning_goal: Asking someone to follow you politely
cards.selection_reason: Reusable modal + infinitive, quicker than the full dialogue turn.

cards.target_text: L'université est à deux minutes d'ici.
cards.base_text: The university is two minutes from here.

teaching_examples.text: Je travaille ici. C'est à deux minutes d'ici.
teaching_examples.base_text: I work here. It's two minutes from here.

cards.learning_goal: Locating a place nearby using distance
cards.selection_reason: A natural teacher example combining two useful elements from different original lines.

teacher_analysis.summary: Teach a polite campus direction request and the location/distance frame using short reusable phrases rather than entire turns.

discarded_candidates.text: Vous pouvez me suivre, c'est à deux minutes d'ici.
discarded_candidates.reason: Two independent language functions in one long retrieval; split the skills into shorter chunks.
